name: Convolution reverb, a 2 s hall, wet only
notes: Fancy Verb against MConvolutionEZ (MeldaProduction, free), 100 % wet. A convolution reverb's cost follows its IR's length, so match the lengths: MConvolutionEZ plays its 'Large 01' IR (set by parameter); Fancy Verb's IR isn't a host parameter, so it loads a preset saved from REAPER: File module > Library > Halls, the IR closest in length, Wet 0 dB, Dry off, then the FX window's + menu > Export VST preset, as examples/presets/fancy-verb-hall.vstpreset. Distortion and aliasing aren't measured: convolution is linear.
